title: LinMorph: Learning to Morph Weights for Efficient Video DiT Linearization
title_zh: LinMorph：学习权重形态转换，实现高效的 Video DiT 线性化

paragraphs.en: LinMorph 是一种学习权重形态转换的方法，用于高效地线性化预训练的 Video DiT 模型。 Post-hoc linearization is an attractive way to accelerate pretrained Video Diffusion Transformers (Video DiTs), yet existing methods largely treat the quality loss induced by attention replacement as a recovery problem. We show that a more fundamental bottleneck lies upstream: \emph{initialization}. Random initialization discards pretrained knowledge, whereas manual weight reuse transfers it through rigid and incomplete source--target correspondences. We introduce \textbf{LinMorph}, which recasts Video DiT linearization as a learnable softmax-to-linear weight transformation problem. Instead of copying predefined counterparts, LinMorph learns a cross-parameter morphism that lets each target Gated DeltaNet (GDN) parameter draw jointly from pretrained query, key, value, and output projections, including for parameters with no direct softmax counterpart. A single morphism is shared across layers and learned through local teacher alignment, while producing layer-specific initializations from their respective pretrained weights. The resulting weights are then materialized as independent GDN modules for progressive distillation and joint recovery.Since the morphism operates in weight space rather than token space, it can be learned on short, low-resolution clips and directly reused at larger video scales. Across pretrained Video DiTs, LinMorph enables markedly faster recovery and better final generation quality than random initialization and heuristic weight reuse. Results show that efficient linearization depends not only on how a converted model is recovered, but critically on how pretrained knowledge is transferred before recovery. Project page: https://lonelyling.github.io/LinMorph.
paragraphs.zh: LinMorph 是一种学习权重形态转换的方法，用于高效地将预训练的 Video DiT 模型线性化。事后线性化是加速预训练视频扩散变换器（Video DiTs）的一种有吸引力的方法，但现有方法大多将注意力替换所导致的质量损失视为一个恢复问题。 我们发现，一个更根本的瓶颈存在于上游：\emph{初始化}。 随机初始化会丢弃预训练知识，而手动重用权重则通过僵化且不完整的源-目标对应关系来传递这些知识。 我们提出了 \textbf{LinMorph}，它将 Video DiT 的线性化问题重新表述为一个可学习的从 softmax 到线性权重的转换问题。 LinMorph 不会复制预定义的目标参数，而是学习一种跨参数的形态映射，使得每个目标门控 DeltaNet（GDN）参数都能联合地从预训练的查询、键、值和输出投影中获取信息，包括那些没有直接 softmax 对应参数的情况。 整个模型共享一个形态映射，并通过局部教师对齐进行学习，同时为各层生成基于其各自预训练权重的特定初始化。 最终得到的权重会被实现为独立的 GDN 模块，用于渐进式蒸馏和联合恢复。由于该形态映射在权重空间中而非令牌空间中操作，因此可以在短小、低分辨率的视频片段上学习，并直接应用于更大规模的视频。 在多种预训练的 Video DiT 模型中，LinMorph 相比随机初始化和启发式权重重用方法，实现了显著更快的恢复速度和更优的最终生成质量。 实验结果表明，高效的线性化不仅取决于转换后模型的恢复方式，更关键地依赖于在恢复之前如何传递预训练知识。 项目页面：https://lonelyling.github.io/LinMorph.
